coordinateContract: sourceRect uses original source pixels; sprites and textures are native crops. Entity foot positions are owned by map-layout/runtime. Draw object nativeSize*1.25; depth-sort by entity footY, using footPivot. Use separate small collider, never canopy bounds.

coniferBlue.assemblyNote: Visible original blue conifer canopy plus exposed original rooted trunk; occluded original conifer trunk cannot be recovered. No image generation, resize or recoloring.

limitations: Flattened reference cannot reveal terrain hidden by trunks/canopies; engine repeats sampled terrain tokens beneath source-derived tree objects.
Blue conifer is explicitly assembled from visible original canopy and exposed original trunk components because its reference trunk is occluded.
Terrain tokens may contain tiny existing marks from the original pixel artwork; no reconstructed unseen original background is claimed.
Art extraction does not certify runtime layout, collision, story flow or visual acceptance.
